thesis: Mathematical unification permits shared empirical correction without settling ultimate metaphysics.
role: Explain the theological and mechanical origins and limits of modern law.

ideas.statement: Newtonian unification separates predictive utility from satisfaction about ultimate mechanism, while metaphysical justification cannot guarantee correct physics.
Public reproducible methods can weaken status-based authority, but mathematical expertise can overreach unless its assumptions and limits remain visible.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Science replacing religion is too linear a history; machine explanations may be too narrow for organisms, mind or society.
